headline: Egypt Develops Electronic System to Tighten Fuel Distribution Oversight
summary: The Ministry of Petroleum and Mineral Resources has developed a detailed framework for an electronic system to oversee petroleum product distribution and curb illegal practices, in coordination with other ministries.
why: Digital monitoring of state-subsidized or distributed commodities helps control fiscal expenditures and prevent black-market diversion.

impacts.name: Egypt
impacts.why: Enhanced oversight of fuel distribution impacts national energy resource management.
